subject.title: fix(whatsapp): cache bot's own outbound messages for quote metadata (#91445)

question: Should this WhatsApp Desktop reply-rendering fix wait for live Desktop/group proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the contributor proof gate?
rationale: The patch is a plausible narrow source fix, but the reported failure is a client-rendering behavior that the contributor has not demonstrated in a real WhatsApp Desktop setup.

options.title: Require Desktop Proof First
options.body: Ask for a redacted WhatsApp Desktop/group screenshot, recording, terminal/live output, or logs proving the after-fix reply bubble renders for a swipe-reply to a bot-authored message.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can independently validate the Desktop group flow and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep this PR open but unmerged, or replace it with a maintainer-tested branch, if no real WhatsApp proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted WhatsApp Desktop/group screenshot, recording, terminal/live output, or logs proving the after-fix reply bubble renders for a swipe-reply to a bot-authored message.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent history in the echo-suppression path involved in this bug.
